react.initial_search_query: Find the names of all cards illustrated by John Avon that are legal in the 'duel' format and have a non-null cardKingdomId but a null cardKingdomFoilId. Return only those with the highest converted mana cost among John Avon's cards meeting these criteria.

entity role: all cards illustrated by John Avon
filter role: legal in the 'duel' format

SELECT COUNT("XCL_001") FROM cards WHERE ("XCL_007" IS NULL OR "XCL_006" IS NULL) AND "XCL_002" = 'John Avon'

SELECT T1."XCL_051", T2."XCL_084" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'mythic' AND NOT T1."XCL_051" IS NULL AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal' ORDER BY T1."XCL_051" LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_019", T1."XCL_049", IIF(T2."XCL_085" = 'Banned', T1."XCL_049", 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Allen Williams'

SELECT COUNT(T1."XCL_001") FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_090" WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'premodern' AND T3."XCL_089" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.' AND T1."XCL_064" IS NULL

WITH MaxBanned AS (SELECT "XCL_084", COUNT(*) AS count_banned FROM legalities WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned' GROUP BY "XCL_084" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT T2."XCL_084", T1."XCL_049" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2."XCL_086" = T1."XCL_072" INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS MB ON MB."XCL_084" = T2."XCL_084" WHERE T2."XCL_085" = 'Banned'

SELECT T1."XCL_001", T1."XCL_002" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086" WHERE T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal' AND T2."XCL_084" = 'commander' AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')

SELECT DISTINCT T2."XCL_049", CASE WHEN T1."XCL_085" = 'Legal' THEN T1."XCL_084" ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2."XCL_072" = T1."XCL_086" WHERE T2."XCL_063" IN (SELECT "XCL_099" FROM sets WHERE "XCL_110" = 'Hour of Devastation')
